objections.rationale: The borrower asked "Is that going to be a problem?" The agent avoided any credit decision ("I'm not able to weigh in on that myself. A licensed member loan officer looks at the full picture") and kept collecting details. It closed the loop at [18] with "they can also answer your question about the $30k." The initial reply was a bit curt and offered no reassurance before pivoting to the next question.

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are brief, one question per turn, and adapt well ("A ballpark is fine," "It's fine if you're not sure," "not a credit check"). The repeated "Thanks" openers feel somewhat formulaic. The closing line "You can wait until then, so there's no rush" reads awkwardly.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower knows a licensed loan officer will call "tomorrow, Thursday, around 2pm Pacific" at this number, and their $30k concern was explicitly carried forward ([18], [20]). The deflection at [6] left the borrower's worry unaddressed for most of the chat, which is mild friction.

annotations.note: Discloses up front that this is "an automated assistant," asks for permission, and gives the STOP opt-out.
Correctly refuses to judge whether $30k cash-out is "a problem," avoiding a credit decision despite a borderline LTV, and routes the question to a licensed loan officer.
"I'm not able to weigh in on that myself" pivots immediately to the next question without a brief reassurance, which may feel dismissive to a worried borrower.
Credit question clearly frames itself as "just your own estimate, not a credit check" and offers a "not sure" option, which lowers anxiety.
Sets an honest next step and explicitly promises the loan officer will address "your question about the $30k," closing the loop on the borrower's concern.
"You can wait until then, so there's no rush" is awkward, slightly confusing filler in an otherwise clean confirmation.

judge.overall_notes: This is a clean, compliant intake: the agent never hinted at a rate, an approval, or a credit decision, even when asked directly whether the cash-out would be a problem. Minor polish is needed on warmth when deflecting and on the closing wording.
